verifiedBehavior.evidence: The patched shared HostProcess.poll passively discovers only the full exact private-profile argv; no discovery returns None without interpreting any launcher status as browser exit. The existing 35-second cause connection deadline and mandatory verify_session remain.

verify_session still checks Marionette PID/profile/full executable argv and now rejects a different previously observed identity before _adopt; identical adoption retains the existing queue. Existing exit observation and pre-signal identity revalidation remain.

No-discovery close only reaps its own launcher. native_cause cannot mark cleanup complete without an observed browser identity and a post-close non-None browser poll. Snapshot and per-resource cleanup exceptions are caught independently; an earlier errorCode is retained.

The final snapshot reads launcher status, polls browser/kernel state, then reads plain exit_code/exited from that same state. It does not invoke the state-changing returncode property after calculating liveness. A passed probe requires alive, verified ownership, no observed browser exit code and no requested signal.

Each of three streams reads at most a 65536-byte tail; only fixed marker names, counts, booleans and numeric process statuses enter the report. Raw text, argv, private paths, token/nonce values and OS stderr are not copied. Suite projection retains only allowed startup fields/markers.

Preflight retains the original four harness hashes; prepare_harness checks immutable patch/base hashes, performs git apply --check/apply and checks the final harness hash. The report includes original commit plus patch/base/post hashes.

Controlled authentication PID/kernel binding, launch-cancelled first cause, connected-before-disconnect, actual browser BuildID/debug/protection checks, content sandbox level 3 with no override, trusted context-menu assertions and GUI tests remain required. Runtime C++ patch remains unchanged.
